notes.title: Now Available: English Version Release!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce the release of the English version of our game. Set in the uniquely captivating locale of Okinawa, Japan, this story offers a glimpse into a culture and setting rarely known in the English-speaking world.

This heartfelt romantic comedy is sure to leave you both laughing and moved. To celebrate the launch, we’re offering a limited-time sale for one week. Don’t miss this chance to dive into a one-of-a-kind experience!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290190/7f10aceb12dbd04d137ecc9f03b2477ea4044c2b.png[/img]

notes.title: English Version Launches on Oct 22—A Story That Will Touch Your Heart!
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for waiting! We’re thrilled to announce that the English version will officially launch on October 22nd! Get ready to experience a story that's not only beautiful but will make you laugh and cry. Please note that the Steam version won't include the setting materials collection or some of the after stories, so be sure to check those out console!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290190/e33c5a4391d7dd351de43d0e3a5ceb32710a6d6c.png[/img]

notes.title: English version will come out in autumn
notes.notes:
Thanks to our partners we can publish an English version in autumn. Note that the title will be changed to [b]"Tales from Toyotoki: Arrival of the Witch"[/b] but the contents are the same. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290190/5cbe3cf85ae43d284ee4de57b86401113cf2c6fd.png[/img]

notes.title: 『이하나시의 마녀』 공식 한국어 패치!
notes.notes:
Fragaria의 『이하나시의 마녀』에 공식 한국어 패치가 추가되었습니다!
 이번 업데이트로 많은 한국 분들이 오키나와의 정서와 귀엽고 사랑스런 캐릭터들, 재미와 감동으로 가득한 이야기를 즐겨 주셨으면 합니다.
 
 번역 및 인게임 내 오류와 관련하여 제안 사항이나 의견이 있으신 분은 언제든 저희에게 알려주시기 바랍니다.

Now we support Korean. Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290190/5edb0c53a29dd8432c707260a191ba22c5444b69.png[/img]

notes.title: イハナシの魔女（JP）V1.2公開のお知らせ
notes.notes:
日本版の誤字脱字や一部UIの表示不具合を修正いたしました。セーブデータの互換性は確認しておりますが、万が一、不具合があればご連絡ください。

Fixed version has been released (only for Japanese edition)

notes.title: DLCの追加
notes.notes:
コミックマーケット101で頒布した「イハナシの魔女　Append」の配信を開始しました。日本語版のみの対応です。 
A new mini-novel and artworks "The witch of the Ihanashi Append" is on sale. Currently, we only support Japanese.
